name: eien
displayName: Eien - Copilot Chat Auto-Continue & Credit Limit
description: Auto-continue and auto-approve Copilot Chat overnight (AFK), cap Copilot credits and premium requests with a strict budget limit, and save Git rollback checkpoints.

eien.maxHours.description: Maximum number of hours Eien may run.

eien.idleSeconds.description: Seconds without a chat-file update before a stall is considered.

eien.maxInterventions.description: Maximum number of resume prompts Eien may send.

eien.autoClickApprovals.description: Use the operating system accessibility API to click a known chat approval button. Falls back to a continuation prompt when unavailable.
